description: Creates and updates pages in Notion. Pins Notion-Version 2022-06-28 and uses database_id -- see the versioning risk note in handler.py about the 2025-09-03 switch to data_source_id.

commands.name: create_page
commands.description: Creates a page in a database (POST /pages). Used by create_notion_profile.

properties.description: Notion properties' exact format depends on the target database's column schema.

commands.name: update_page
commands.description: Updates an existing page's properties (PATCH /pages/{id}). Used by mark_onboarding_complete.
